title: Web API
description: Build and consume RESTful Web APIs using ASP.NET Core.
longDescription: This module teaches you how to create Web APIs using ASP.NET Core following RESTful patterns. You will learn about HTTP verbs, routing for APIs, returning JSON responses, and consuming APIs from JavaScript and jQuery.
whatYouLearn: Create Web API controllers with proper HTTP verbs
Return JSON responses and HTTP status codes
Consume APIs from JavaScript using XMLHttpRequest
Call Web APIs from jQuery in ASP.NET Core
